capabilities: organize notes into a sidebar hierarchy via decimal frontmatter numbers
show the current note's headings with live reading-position highlighting
navigate to previous and next notes by decimal sequence
generate chapter and subject rollups from shared decimal prefixes
define custom sidebar sections by prefix, depth, and icon
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Notes without a dwno property still get the outline view but show a notice about decimal sequencing.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to order and navigate notes as a deep, numbered book-like hierarchy from note metadata.
summary: Sidebar navigation plugin that organizes notes into a hierarchy and live outlines using dot-separated decimal numbers (dwno) stored in frontmatter.
